lines: Ruko! Ye bike asli mein British thi!
Ek zamaane mein iske rider... aise hote the.
Par unnees sau sattar mein, England mein iska production band ho gaya.
Lekin India mein... ye kahani zinda rahi.
Bullet sirf bike nahi thi... ek rutba thi.
Pachaas ke dashak mein, ye England se ship pe aayi.
Indian Army ne order diya... aur Madras mein Enfield India bani.
Phir aayi halki, zyada mileage wali bikes...
Phir Eicher ne company sambhali... aur bike ko theek kiya.
Naye boss Siddhartha Lal ka faisla: focus sirf Bullet pe!
Bike nayi bani... aur Ladakh trips ne ise sapna bana diya.
Aaj baarah lakh se zyada bikes... assi se zyada desh!
Aapki dream Royal Enfield kaunsi hai? Comment karo... aur follow karo!
